text:
dana: Quick check — we're rotating TLS certs for internal-inference-gateway tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Can owners confirm KMS key access, session-ticket rotation plan, and that logs won't leak raw handshake data? cc @sam @kevin

sam: I can own the gateway rotation. KMS key is `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/inference-gw`. Need IAM for kevin + ops service to create new key versions and test decryption.

kevin: I don't currently have the KMS role. Please grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `kevin@redwood.com` and `ops-service@redwood-ci`. I'll run the rotation steps and can do the canary.

maria: Filed the grant request -> JIRA INFRA-5321, approver set to `security@redwood.com`. ETA for approval: EOD today.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: cert reload scheduled: 2026-02-10T03:00:00Z for service internal-inference-gateway (rolling, 1m gap between nodes).

security-bot: Policy check: public endpoints must be TLS1.3-only; internal services can allow TLS1.2 for legacy clients but prefer TLS1.3. Rotation note: remember to rotate session_ticket keys and session ticket lifetime to avoid client-stale sessions. Also confirm logs/redaction for handshake errors (do not log `ClientHello` raw bytes).

dana: Thanks. Kevin — can you add a session-ticket key rotation in the plan? Canary 2 nodes then 10% then full. Also we need to make sure handshake error logs redact `client_random` and any TLS extensions.

kevin: Will add rollout policy. PR incoming with the ops manifest and rollout: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/234

kevin: For shorthand here's the steps I'll run:
```
# create new key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/inference-gw
# update service to use new certificate (cert stored in Secret Manager)
kubectl set env deploy/inference-gateway TLS_CERT_SECRET=new-cert-v2
# reload pods with zero-downtime strategy
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-gateway --timeout=10m
```

sam: Logging redaction snippet for Envoy that we should apply to the gateway's access/error logs — strip client_random & raw extensions:
```
transformations:
  - type: regex_replace
    field: "error_message"
    pattern: "(client_random=)[0-9a-fA-F]+"
    replacement: "\1[REDACTED]"
  - type: regex_replace
    field: "error_message"
    pattern: "(tls_extensions=)\\[[^\\]]+\\]"
    replacement: "\1[REDACTED]"
```

maria: Security reviewed the JIRA and approved temporary KMS binding for kevin and `ops-service` for 24 hours around the rotation window. Approval note: `security@redwood.com` — keep audit logs and revoke after verification. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll run the canary tonight: canary plan = 2 nodes (03:00–03:15), 10% traffic 03:15–03:30, 50% 03:30–03:45 then full. Will monitor TLS handshake error rate and token auth errors. If error rate > 0.5% in any window I'll roll back immediately.

dana: Also ensure the CI integration tests exercise TLS renegotiation and session resume flows — caught an edge case last time where session tickets weren't accepted after rotation.

kevin: Good call, adding test job `ci/tls-session-resume` to the rotation PR.

security-bot: Reminder: rotate session ticket keys in both gateway and edge LB to avoid resume failures. Document how to roll back ticket keys and timeline in INFRA-5321.

maria: Confirmed — security approval added to JIRA, temporary IAM granted, and logs redaction rules pre-applied in staging. I'll revoke extra IAM once this is verified.

sam: One more quick check — do we need to bump minimum TLS for internal-metrics exporter? It talks to gateways, so we should ensure exporter supports TLS1.3 or allow fallback to 1.2 during the window.

dana: Keep exporter at TLS1.2/1.3 for the window, we'll hard-enforce 1.3 after a 48h observation period.

ops-bot: Rotation completed on canary nodes at 03:12 UTC. Monitoring graphs: handshake_errors = 0.02% (ok).

kevin: Canary looks good, ramping to 10%. Monitoring continues.

maria: Security logs show no leaked client_randoms. IAM revoked for `kevin@redwood.com` and `ops-service@redwood-ci` at 05:15 UTC per policy. Closing INFRA-5321 after post-mortem.

dana: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post the post-rotate checklist & lessons learned in #eng-postmortems later today.
